name: Trishal
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate first-party discovery checks in English and Bengali identified the official DLRS settlement map/search viewer and the official Trishal Upazila Land Office. The live viewer's current JavaScript was followed through the public division, district, survey and upazila routes. Mymensingh RS survey discovery succeeded, but the public upazila route returned an empty array, so no safe parcel ID+geometry response, schema/CRS or GeoJSON sample was retained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [24.5776979509509, 90.3836042372999] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point query was possible.
A zero or empty traversal response, map extent limitation, timeout, login wall or unusable public route is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

No retained GeoJSON sample exists because no unchanged native parcel geometry and stable native ID were obtained anonymously.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No native parcel identity was observed in a safe anonymous response; no synthetic identity was created.

uncertainty: A first-party Trishal Upazila Land Office and national DLRS cadastral/survey custodian are evidenced. Public parcel integration is not admitted: the official viewer's Mymensingh survey-to-upazila request returned no options, and no safe anonymous ID+geometry response or CRS was observed. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception or unsafe field request was used.
